Pedro Sánchez hits out at ‘polarising and unlawful reaction’ over mass crossing into Spanish enclave in north Africa

Europe live – latest updates

Spain’s prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, has called for an urgent meeting of EU interior ministers after what he called some member states’ “selfish, polarising and unlawful reaction” to this week’s mass border crossing into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta, in north Africa.

At least 57 people have died trying to reach the Spanish enclave of Ceuta after as many as 50,000 migrants entered the tiny territory from Morocco in what Spain’s prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, called “a violation of Spain’s territorial integrity”.

The latest numbers of confirmed cases of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has made this latest outbreak the fastest growing in the known history of the virus.
At 3,360 confirmed cases, the disease is now affecting people in five provinces in the east of the DRC, with 1,487 deaths recorded, representing an overall case fatality rate estimated at about 45%, according to Congolese health officials. Health responses to the outbreak have been badly hampered by conflict in many of the affected areas.

articles.title: HIV prevention drug could reduce cases globally but USAID cuts prevent access, say experts
articles.description:
Injectable PrEP drug holds promise but investment in HIV prevention has declined dramatically worldwide

Sign up for the Breaking News US newsletter email 

New innovations in HIV prevention could dramatically reduce the number of new HIV cases around the globe, but US foreign aid cuts will mean that those that most need the new medication will be unable to access it, according to experts at the Aids 2026 Conference in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
One year ago, the World Health Organization recommended that governments around the world prioritize expanded access to lenacapavir, an injectable version of the HIV prevention medication PrEP that requires only two injections annually. PrEP, which also comes in the form of daily oral medications and bimonthly injections, is 99% effective in preventing sexually transmitted HIV for people who take it consistently.

Canadians spent $3.3bn less on travel to the US in 2025 than in the previous year, as Donald Trump’s hostile policies towards his northern neighbour continue to incur an economic cost, new government data shows.

The current fires and their plumes of smoke can appear to be a temporary, if immediate, crisis. Nearly 1,000 fires have sprung into life in the boreal forests of Canada, causing the evacuation of towns and toxic smoke to waft into major Canadian and US cities, prompting threats of retribution from Donald Trump, who bizarrely accused Canada of “poisoning” his country’s air.

articles.title: How these twins' rare growth disorder could provide the key to preventing cancer

articles.titleJa: 珍しい成長障害を持つ双子が、がん予防の鍵となる可能性

articles.summary: カルテルメンバーと元同僚が、張志東容疑者が中国の化学物質をメキシコの麻薬製造所にどのように結びつけたかを語る。

articles.title: 'I ate ketchup and cheese,' says Venezuelan girl trapped under quake rubble for 32 hours

articles.title: Weaponizing citizenship: Silencing dissent in Nicaragua

articles.titleJa: 市民権を武器化する：ニカラグアで反対意見を封じ込める
articles.summary: ニカラグアにおける権威主義的な政権が、市民権剥奪を武器に反対派を沈黙させようとしている状況を検証する。

articles.title: How much will it take to rebuild Venezuela after the earthquakes?
articles.description: Early damage estimates vary widely, but all point to the same conclusion: rebuilding Venezuela will require unprecedented financial resources and long-term economic recovery efforts.
articles.titleJa: 地震後のベネズエラを再建するには、どれほどの費用がかかるのか？
articles.summary: ベネズエラは地震後の再建に前例のない財源と長期的な経済復興努力が必要。被害見積もりは大きく異なるが、この結論は共通している。

articles.title: From Mexico to Venezuela: A diaspora’s race to save lives
articles.description: From Mexico, Venezuelans mobilized within hours, building trusted networks to deliver aid and proving that solidarity can cross any border.
articles.titleJa: メキシコからベネズエラへ：ディアスポラの命を救う競争
articles.summary: メキシコ在住のベネズエラ人たちが、緊急に組織化して信頼できるネットワークを構築し、祖国ベネズエラへ援助物資を届け、国境を越えた連帯を示した。

articles.title: How an AI research tool helped challenge support for police violence in Brazil
articles.description: In 2023, Brazil recorded 45,747 intentional violent deaths — among the highest rates in the world. Like many democracies, the country has long grappled with the issue of large-scale public support for state violence.
articles.titleJa: AI研究ツールがブラジルにおける警察暴力への支持に異議を唱えるのにどう役立ったか

articles.title: 70 years on, Argentine court declares ‘Operation Massacre’ a crime against humanity

articles.title: Venezuela earthquakes reveal a child protection system unprepared for disaster
articles.description: After Venezuela’s earthquakes, families searched for missing children within a strained protection system that struggled to respond amid collapsed buildings, scarce resources, and institutional gaps.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震、災害に備えのない児童保護システムを露呈
articles.summary: ベネズエラの地震発生後、崩壊した建物、資源不足、制度的欠陥の中で、児童保護システムが対応に苦慮し、行方不明の子供たちを家族が捜索する状況が明らかになった。

articles.title: Why Venezuela’s earthquakes were so devastating: Geology, vulnerability, and years of structural neglect
articles.description: The dual earthquakes revealed how geology, corruption, and a longstanding humanitarian emergency amplified destruction across La Guaira, Caracas and seven other Venezuelan cities.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震がなぜこれほど壊滅的だったのか：地質、脆弱性、長年の構造的怠慢

articles.title: Follow the story: Local journalists, media and advocates covering Venezuela’s earthquakes

articles.title: Massive Attack banned from Singapore after pro-Palestine display at show

articles.title: Millions opposed military rule in Myanmar. Is their dream of a revolution over?
articles.description: Opponents of the junta hoped a revolution would remake Myanmar - but these are disheartening times.

articles.title: India wants to join the strawberry superpowers
articles.description: Indian strawberry farmers rely on varieties imported from the US and Europe, but that could change.
articles.titleJa: インドは「イチゴ大国」の仲間入りを望む
articles.summary: インドのイチゴ農家は欧米からの輸入品種に頼るが、自国での品種開発を進め「イチゴ大国」を目指す可能性が浮上している。

articles.title: Japan earthquake death toll rises to 34 as evacuees battle sweltering heat

articles.title: Australia takes Telegram to court over alleged failure to remove 'pro-terror' material
articles.description: Telegram told the BBC it rejects the allegations and will contest them in court.
articles.titleJa: オーストラリア、テロ擁護的コンテンツ削除怠ったとしてテレグラムを提訴

articles.title: BTS withdraw from Grammys, a month after Asian pop prize introduced
articles.description: All seven members of the band post a statement online, saying they will boycott the 2027 ceremony.

articles.title: 'I won't stop fighting,' says 'cockroach' protester after alleged detention

articles.summary: 抗議活動への関与を理由に警察に不法拘束されたとされるモハマド・ジュナイド氏が、法廷に異議を申し立て、「戦い続ける」と表明した。

articles.title: 'It took everything from us': India's Assam faces worst floods in years
articles.description: While flooding happens in Assam every year, a state minister described this year as the worst in six decades.
articles.titleJa: 「全てを奪われた」：インドのアッサム州が数十年ぶりの最悪の洪水に直面
articles.summary: インドのアッサム州が60年で最悪とされる洪水に見舞われ、住民は「全てを奪われた」と語る。甚大な被害が報告されている。

articles.title: Global goods trade resilient in the first quarter of 2026 despite war in Middle East
articles.description: World merchandise trade growth exceeded expectations in the first quarter of 2026 as surging trade in electronic components related to artificial intelligence (AI) offset the negative impact of the conflict in the Middle East, which began in the final month of the quarter. Trade disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz are expected to be more fully captured in trade data for the next quarter.
articles.titleJa: グローバル商品貿易、2026年第1四半期は中東での戦争にもかかわらず回復力を示す
articles.summary: 2026年第1四半期の世界の商品貿易は、AI関連の電子部品の貿易急増により、中東紛争の影響を相殺し、予想を上回る成長を見せた。

articles.title: Brazil initiates dispute regarding additional duties imposed by the United States
articles.description: Brazil has requested WTO dispute consultations with the United States regarding additional US duties on products originating in Brazil as a result of two investigations by the United States under Section 301 of the US Trade Act of 1974. Brazil said the additional duties are above the duties otherwise applicable under the US harmonized tariff schedule. The request was circulated to WTO members on 30 July.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル、米国が課した追加関税について紛争解決手続きを開始
articles.summary: ブラジルは、米国が自国製品に課した追加関税についてWTOに紛争協議を要請。米国貿易法301条に基づく調査が背景にある。

articles.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
articles.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
articles.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコのEVなど自動車に関する措置について報告書を発行
articles.summary: WTOは、中国が提起した「トルコ—中国製電気自動車およびその他の車種に関する措置」のパネル報告書を公開した。

articles.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
articles.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
articles.titleJa: リトアニア、途上国および後発開発途上国の貿易スキル向上支援に3万ユーロを拠出
articles.summary: リトアニアは、途上国および後発開発途上国の政府職員向け研修資金として3万ユーロをWTOグローバル信託基金に拠出し、貿易スキル向上を支援。

articles.title: Uzbekistan reaffirms 2026 WTO accession goal, thanks members for continuing engagement
articles.description: Uzbekistan reaffirmed its determination to complete its WTO accession process within 2026 at a meeting of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan on 27 and 28 July, soon after its last meeting in March. The head of Uzbekistan's delegation, Chief Negotiator Azizbek Urunov, stressed that maintaining a strong pace of engagement and addressing members' remaining concerns will be critical to bringing the accession process to a successful conclusion.
articles.titleJa: ウズベキスタン、2026年までのWTO加盟目標を再確認、継続的な関与に感謝
articles.summary: ウズベキスタンは、2026年までのWTO加盟完了目標を再確認し、作業部会でメンバーとの継続的な協力に感謝を表明した。

articles.title: Russia requests dispute panel on EU carbon border adjustment and emissions trading scheme
articles.description: At a meeting of the Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) on 24 July, members considered a request from the Russian Federation for the establishment of a dispute panel to review the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) Package and alleged export subsidy under the EU scheme for trading greenhouse gas emission allowances. The DSB Chair, Ambassador Guilherme de Aguiar Patriota (Brazil), also updated members on dispute settlement reform consultations and convened an informal discussion after the meeting to further hear members' views.
articles.titleJa: ロシア、EUの炭素国境調整メカニズムと排出量取引制度に関する紛争パネルを要請
articles.summary: ロシアは、EUの炭素国境調整メカニズム（CBAM）パッケージと排出量取引制度における輸出補助金について、WTOに紛争パネル設置を要請した。

articles.title: Why is transit in goods free but trade is not?
articles.description: In my previous two posts on the value of the WTO, I argued that when governments set trade policies independently, they focus on domestic effects but often overlook the costs imposed on trading partners. International trade agreements help governments take account of these cross-border spillovers (terms-of-trade externalities) by encouraging reciprocal negotiations over trade policy. While these negotiations will reduce trade protection, they will not necessarily lead to free trade. But if governments do not generally commit themselves to free trade, why has freedom of transit for goods been seen differently?
articles.titleJa: なぜ物品の通過は自由なのに、貿易はそうではないのか？
articles.summary: 貿易政策が国内効果に焦点を当てがちであることに対し、国際貿易協定が国境を越えた影響を考慮する手助けをする。物品の通過が自由である理由と貿易がそうではない理由を考察。

articles.title: Updated WTO-IMF TPA Index shows continued rise in global trade policy activity
articles.description: A new Trade Policy Activity (TPA) index by WTO and IMF economists shows a marked rise in trade policy activity during 2025-26, alongside heightened trade policy tensions among large economies, against the backdrop of an overall upward trend.
articles.titleJa: 更新されたWTO-IMF貿易政策活動指数、世界的な貿易政策活動の継続的な増加を示す
articles.summary: WTOとIMFのエコノミストによる新指数は、2025-26年に世界的な貿易政策活動が著しく増加し、主要経済国間の緊張も高まっていることを示す。

articles.title: Members review notifications, pandemic preparedness, biodiversity and IP office cooperation
articles.description: At a meeting of the Council for Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS) on 22-23 July, members discussed notifications of intellectual property legislation, pandemic preparedness, technology transfer, the relationship between the TRIPS Agreement and the Convention on Biological Diversity , and cooperation among IP offices. The meeting, chaired by Ambassador Alaa Hegazy (Egypt), also featured updates on technical cooperation and on a side event on genetic resources held the previous day. Members exchanged views and shared practical experiences from a recent workshop on technology transfer and cooperation initiatives.
articles.titleJa: メンバー、通知、パンデミックへの備え、生物多様性、知財機関協力について検討
articles.summary: TRIPS理事会で、知的財産法規の通知、パンデミックへの備え、技術移転、生物多様性条約との関係、知財機関間の協力など幅広い議題が議論された。

articles.title: Trade Policy Review: India
articles.description: The Eighth review of the trade policies and practices of India takes place on 21 and 23 July 2026. The basis for the review is a report by the WTO Secretariat and a report by the Government of India.
articles.titleJa: 貿易政策審査：インド
articles.summary: 2026年7月21日と23日に、インドの貿易政策と慣行に関する第8回審査がWTO事務局とインド政府の報告書に基づいて行われる。
